confidence.note: Competitor prices are from aggregators, not live pricing pages; churn and CAC are benchmarks. Live pricing reads and a 7-day test would raise it.

gross_margin.note: **~87%** (estimate): Stripe USD 0.45 + AI USD 0.10 + misc USD 0.10 on USD 5; lowered 4.5 -> 4 by R4.

ltv_cac.note: LTV **USD 20.9** vs organic CAC USD 37.5 (estimate): **0.56**; AI app churn about 21%/month.

pricing_power.note: Gemini does it **free**; USD 5 already undercuts Eightify's USD 9.99. Lowered 1.5 -> 1 by R4.

build_effort.note: MVP in 1-2 weeks; transcript fetching must run in the user's browser, as **cloud IPs are blocked**.

skills_match.note: A developer can build it; payments, store listing and marketing are learnable.

capital_needed.note: USD 5 store fee plus free tiers; fits USD 500 easily.

time_to_mvp.note: Working extension with paywall in about **2 weeks** at 10 h/week (estimate).

sales_cycle.note: USD 5 is an impulse purchase; reviews show users paying after hitting the free cap.

channel_readiness.note: Chrome Web Store search exists but no audience; dozens of look-alikes compete for the same keyword.

search_demand.note: 'youtube summarizer' about **49.5K** searches, per Exploding Topics.

trend.note: Rising since 2023, but native YouTube Ask and Gemini now absorb the need.

willingness_to_pay.note: Competitors charge USD 9-10/month, but users push for free or lifetime deals.

free_alternatives.note: Gemini, YouTube Ask and Glasp (**2M users**) do the whole job free. Capped at 1.5 by R1.

competitor_density.note: 12+ look-alikes on Product Hunt alone, plus Eightify, NoteGPT, Recall, Merlin.

differentiation.note: 'Cheaper at USD 5' is not a moat; BYO-key extensions already cost 0. Capped by R3.

legal_regulatory.note: Chrome Web Store disclosure and 2026 data-collection rules; US auto-renewal consumer rules.

platform_dependency.note: Depends on YouTube transcripts, the Chrome Web Store and Google, which ships the same feature.

market_risk.note: Google is bundling summaries into YouTube itself; a standalone tool may become redundant.

skills.note: Build skills yes; no stated distribution or growth experience.

assets.note: No audience, data or network stated.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income, no domain passion stated.

cheapest_test: Fake-door landing page for a weekly YouTube channel digest for B2B marketers at USD 19/month; 50 cold DMs plus 2 subreddit posts; count pre-orders in 7 days.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 3 paid pre-orders (USD 19) by day 7 -> stop the digest pivot
Fewer than 20 waitlist sign-ups from 50 DMs and 2 posts by day 7 -> stop
If you build the USD 5 extension anyway: fewer than 10 paying users by week 8 -> archive it

rescue.change: Sell a weekly digest of chosen YouTube channels (competitors, industry) to B2B marketers and analysts at USD 19-29/month.
rescue.why: Fixes free_alternative and pricing_power: Gemini summarizes one video on request, it does not monitor 20 channels and email a digest.
rescue.requires: Cold outreach to 50+ marketers; transcript fetching that survives cloud IP blocks

rescue.change: Ship a bring-your-own-API-key extension for a one-time USD 29 instead of USD 5/month.
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac and churn: no recurring AI cost, matches the lifetime deals buyers prefer; free alternatives remain.
